Ana (partnerships): Quick ask — we're building the marketplace + HW partner cost model. Need standardized inputs from partners: listing fee (percent or flat), reserved term options (1/3/12 mo), minimum commit, early-termination fees, spot preemption probability / average reclaim window, billing granularity (minute/hour), and any region-specific carveouts. Can partnerships gather and paste here? Ideally by EOD Wed. @Sam can you coordinate?
Sam (partnerships): On it. I'll ping CoreWeave / Nebula / Zenith. Preferred format? CSV, simple key:val list, or copy/paste here?
Mike (finops): Prefer CSV with columns: partner, region, sku, reserved_term_months, reserved_price_usd_per_gpu_hour, spot_price_usd_per_gpu_hour, listing_fee_pct, min_commit_gpus, early_termination_fee_usd, billing_granularity, spot_reclaim_avg_minutes. If vendor only provides % discounts, ask for their base list price so we can compute USD/GPU-hour. Also note whether listing fees are charged upfront or amortized.
Cory (legal): Also request any contract language around interrupts and liability caps. Example clause we typically see:
```
Vendor may reclaim spot capacity with 10 minutes notice. Vendor liability for spot interruptions is limited to credits equal to 24 hours of service for affected instances. Early termination fees are prorated based on remaining committed months.
```
If partners propose automatic renewals > 6 months we need to review.
Lina (product): Heads-up: call out volume tiering behavior (discount breakpoints). Non-linear tiers (e.g., 1-10 GPUs 20%, 11-50 GPUs 30%) need explicit rows in the CSV — otherwise the model misstates marginal economics.
Sam (partnerships): I'll create a sheet and paste the link here; will also ask for anonymized sample invoices if they won't share list prices. Expect initial replies by Tue.
Marketplace Bot: Ticket #4527 created: "partner pricing inputs" — assigned to Sam (partnerships).
Mike (finops): If partners push back on raw prices, ask for an "effective USD/GPU-hour" for each tier and a representative workload profile (seq len, tokens/minute) so we can run cost sims. Also ask whether reserved discounts are fixed or subject to annual repricing.
Ana (partnerships): Perfect. Once we collect samples we'll run spot-heavy vs reserved-heavy sims and produce recommendations on listing fee cap and commit windows. Plan to present to GTM on Friday.
Cory (legal): Quick reminder — ask partners to confirm: are listing fees refundable or non-refundable on cancellation? That changes revenue recognition and customer offers.
Sam (partnerships): Outreach sent to CoreWeave & Nebula this morning, Zenith next. Will paste partial responses as they come.
Mike (finops): Example datapoint from a past partner (for reference): reserved (12mo) = $2.40 / GPU-hour, spot = $0.65 / GPU-hour, listing fee = 6% of revenue, min_commit = 25 GPUs, early_termination_fee = prorated remaining months * reserved_rate. Use as a sanity check only.
Lina (product): :thumbsup:
Marketplace Bot: Reminder — weekly partner sync Wed 10:00am. Adding pricing inputs as agenda item.
Ana (partnerships): Thanks all — Sam, please ping again Tue morning if we haven't heard back.
Sam (partnerships): Will do.
